newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iraq seen cutting March Asia crude formula-traders.
newsitem.headline: Iraq seen cutting March Asia crude formula-traders.

text.p: Iraq's state oil firm (SOMO) is expected to set the price formula for March-loading Basrah Light to Asia at a premium of five cents to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations, down 15 cents from February, traders said on Wednesday.
Traders said Iraq uses the monthly price formula of Saudi Arabia"s Arab Light crude to Asia as a guide in setting the price of Basrah Light.
Basrah Light crude is priced 55 cents per barrel below Arab Light crude, they said.
Saudi Arabia has cut the March price formula for Arab Light crude to Asia by 15 cents from February, to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations plus 60 cents.

Japanese traders said that Iraq has yet to officially notify them of the March price formula, but sources close to SOMO indicated that the price differential with Arab Light would be maintained at 55 cents for March.
